Similarly, if this forecast relates to something like supply chains or commodity prices, disruptions such as natural disasters, strikes, or technological failures could cause outcomes to deviate significantly. These possibilities highlight how uncertainty can compound over time and why longer-term forecasts inherently carry more risk.
